page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression performing in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance in stress-ng, PassMark, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Memory bandwidth is average, with read-only large block speeds at 92.61 GB/sec and write speeds at 43.13 GB/sec, though the overall PassMark memory score is weak.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge offers a high density of dedicated physical cores relative to its memory capacity, making it a viable option for parallelizable workloads that do not demand high single-thread performance or massive memory footprints. It is well-suited for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It can also handle basic text processing and small-to-medium language model inference, though it is not optimized for large-scale AI workloads due to the absence of GPU acceleration.
